ACC / DRIVER HUB

Privacy

How ATXRACING uses driver account, race result and ranking data.

01

Controller and contact

ATX Racing, the event division of ATX Motorsport, processes platform data. For questions or requests: athoxmotorsport@gmail.com.

02

Data processed

Steam sign-in provides your public Steam ID64, name, profile URL and avatar. You may add a team, country, number, biography, photo and links. The ACC Collector also receives race results and driving data.

03

Purposes and legal bases

Authentication provides the requested service (GDPR Article 6(1)(b)). Publishing results, sporting integrity and abuse prevention rely on legitimate interest (6(1)(f)). Optional profile information relies on consent (6(1)(a)).

04

Publication and ratings

Public races may display names, cars, lap times, rankings and statistics. Performance and SAFE are automatically calculated sporting indicators. Report an error to request a review.

05

Providers

Supabase hosts data and functions, GitHub Pages serves the public pages, and Valve/Steam provides identification. Their own policies and possible international transfers may apply.

06

Retention and security

Sessions expire after 7 days. Active profiles and sporting results may be retained for league archives. Tokens are hashed on the server; private functions require a valid session.

07

Your rights

You may request access, correction, erasure, restriction, portability or object to certain processing. You may withdraw consent for optional information. Contact us to exercise these rights.

08

Complaints

You may contact the Belgian Data Protection Authority or a competent authority in your country of residence.

09

Local storage

The selected language is reflected in the URL. A sign-in token is stored in browser session storage; the initial profile guide remembers your choice in local storage. We do not use targeted advertising.

10

Changes

This notice may change as the site develops. Check the published version for the current policy.

athoxmotorsport@gmail.com
